 Stephon Castle posts double-double in Wednesday's win over Mavericks 
 by Chris Schommer | Spurs Correspondent | Fri, Nov 6th 2026, 9:46pm EST 
 Stephon Castle posted a double-double for the Spurs Wednesday night, grabbing 10 rebounds and chipping in 17 points (6-20 FG, 2-9 3PT, 3-4 FT) while also dishing out three assists in a 112-111 win over the Mavericks. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Castle continues a solid stretch on both ends of the floor, dishing out three or more assists, grabbing five or more rebounds, and scoring 14 or more points in four of his last five games. The 22-year-old remains one of many versatile options in the San Antonio starting five for head coach Mitch Johnson, averaging 15.0 points, 1.0 steals, 4.8 assists, and 6.1 rebounds per game while posting a 24.1% usage rate so far this season.
